label: One worker
method: Synthetic inputs: 360 partitions at six partitions per worker-hour. One worker needs 360/6 = 60 hours; three need 360/(3 × 6) = 20 hours under ideal scaling. Both consume 60 worker-hours. Coordination, contention and skew are excluded, so this is not a cost-saving claim.
